name: Should I accept the highest offer, or are there other factors to consider when reviewing multiple offers?

mainEntity.name: Should I accept the highest offer, or are there other factors to consider when reviewing multiple offers?

acceptedAnswer.text: While the highest offer is attractive, it's not always the best. Consider the buyer's financing pre-approval, the size of their earnest money deposit, desired closing date, contingencies (like inspection or appraisal), and reputation of their lender. A strong cash offer with no contingencies, even if slightly lower, can be more reliable than a highly-contingent, higher-priced offer. Kelby Contreras helps clients evaluate all terms to ensure the chosen offer aligns with their priorities and minimizes potential risks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Don't just consider the highest offer; evaluate financing, contingencies, closing date, and buyer reliability to minimize risks.
